I love the feel of leather when I fidget, hence Fidget Newton. But I kept hearing, “Can you make a less expensive version?” The short answer? Not with full leather. The long answer? Enter Fidget Moons.

Fidget Moons are a pair of magnetic fidgets with a 3D-printed core and leather stretched over the dome and under the rim, so your fingers still land on leather with every spin. Snap them together, flip one over and they push apart, roll them in your palm, spin them end over end.

Rolled in your hand, they're quiet enough for a meeting or a classroom. Snap them together and you get a satisfying magnetic clack whenever you want it.

I've been using them for months, and they've earned a permanent spot in my rotation. Even my NT partner can't put them down.

Which Moons are which

  • Fidget Moons: one color of core, one color of leather. The everyday pair, and the easiest place to start.
  • Pride Moons: over 50 flags and identities. 10% of Pride Moons sales go to The Trevor Project. See all the Pride Moons designs.
  • Summer Moons: Red White & Blue, Burger, and Watermelon, right here on this page.
  • Dark Side: a spiked surface you can actually feel under your fingers. See all the Dark Side designs.
  • Oreo Moons: cookie halves in black leather with a white cream center. They started as September's companion Moon in the Cindell of the Month Club, and come back here on their own from time to time.

Questions people ask

What are Fidget Moons made of? A 3D-printed core wrapped in leather over the dome and under the rim, so leather is what your fingers touch.

Are the magnets in Fidget Moons stronger than your other fidgets? No, every Fidget Newton fidget uses the same strength magnet. Fidget Moons just make that snap easy to feel because of how the pair comes together.

Can I choose my own colors? Yes, see the Custom Fidget Moons page for over 100 combinations.

HOLIDAY DOG TREATS GALORE

TABLE-WORTHY PROTEINS, PET-APPROVED TASTE

Our single-ingredient treats put Farm to Pet on the map - and not just at the North Pawl! Made of 100% table-grade chicken, turkey, beef or fish with no added flavors or fillers, dogs and cats can't get enough of their pure meaty flavor! Plus, you won't have to worry about tummy troubles from these wholesome natural pet treats - they are easily digestible by furry friends of all breeds and sizes and have just 6-8 healthy calories per chip.

SEASONS TREATINGS TO ALL!

These festive and holiday-hued Chicken Chip, Turkey Chip, Beef Chip and Fish Chip Snack Pack bags are ideal holiday gifts for dogs and cats. Share them with the neighborhood, pass them out at doggy day care or pet playdates, and of course stuff them in all the fur baby stockings! With a dozen bags in each bundle - or two dozen in assorted varieties - you can wish all your fur-riends Seasons Treatings the Farm to Pet way!

SINGLE-INGREDIENT TREATS FOR FOUR-LEGGED FESTIVITIES

Our travel-friendly Snack Packs fit in purses, backpacks, glove compartments - and yes, gift bags and stockings, too! Paw-fect for on the go, to reward good behavior in different environments, and to share the healthy pet treat love with furry friends.

MORE ABOUT THE FARM TO PET HOLIDAY PET TREAT COLLECTION

Celebrate the season with your furry family members with Farm to Pet’s festive holiday pet treat and gift collection! HOW TO USE FARM TO PET DOG TREATS

  • Use as a high-value training reward.
  • Break into pieces for multiple rewards or to give seniors, puppies, small dogs or even cats!
  • Add to wet food for a crunchy surprise.
  • For overzealous pups, feed in your open palm to avoid accidental finger nipping!

Farm to Pet Snack Stuffers are the same as our Snack Packs 6-piece mini bags of dog treats, just all dressed up for the howl-idays! Our holiday pet treat collection includes Holiday Chips and Snack Stuffers bags in all-natural single-ingredient chicken, turkey, beef and fish varieties.

Are Farm to Pet holiday dog treats suitable for all dogs? What about cats?

Yes, our single-ingredient holiday dog treats are suitable for dogs and cats of all breeds and sizes. They are easily digestible and contain only gently-dehydrated table-grade chicken, turkey, beef or fish with no additives or preservatives. They can also be broken up into smaller pieces, or opt for Farm to Pet Crumbles for pets who prefer smaller sized treats.

Use Regret Reserve a drop at a time. Stir a few drops into chili, wings, tacos, or eggs to push the heat into world's-hottest territory, or dare a friend straight from the bottle. Because it is a real pepper blend and not a flavorless extract, you get fruity heat — not just pain.

Frequently Asked Questions

Regret Reserve is the hottest sauce Elijah's Xtreme makes and a genuine contender among the world's hottest hot sauces at an estimated 999,999 SHU*. Unlike many extreme sauces, it is a 70% real pepper blend, so you get fruity, pepper-forward flavor alongside extreme, lingering heat.

What peppers are in Regret Reserve Hot Sauce?

Regret Reserve is a 70% pepper blend built on three of the hottest peppers grown: Carolina Reaper, Trinidad Scorpion, and habanero. That combination delivers fruity flavor up front and an extreme finish, which is what separates this world's-hottest-style sauce from one-note extract-based heat.

Title: Fisher’s Popcorn Tubs
Body (HTML):
The famous Fisher's Popcorn tub — fresh caramel popcorn from the Delmarva beaches & boardwalks, shipped straight to your door. We've hand-made our caramel corn the same way since 1937: air-popped mushroom popcorn, light buttery caramel, one family recipe, zero shortcuts.

This is the popcorn of summers in Fenwick Island, Bethany Beach, and Rehoboth Beach — scooped warm at our beach stands and packed fresh for mail order. One taste and you're back on the boardwalk, salt air and all.

Choose from nine flavors, from the original Caramel and aged White Cheddar to OLD BAY® Caramel and the argument-settling 3-Way Split, in five tub sizes that run from a half-gallon movie night up to a 3.5-gallon party bucket. Every flavor is gluten free, and orders over $50 ship free.

A tub of Fisher's makes an easy gift — birthdays, holidays, thank-yous, and homesick Delaware beach people everywhere. And when the popcorn's gone, the tub isn't done: bring it back to any of our stands for a discounted refill, or promote it to sandcastle duty. The tub's second life is a beach tradition of its own.

The famous Fisher's Popcorn tub — fresh caramel popcorn from the Delmarva beaches & boardwalks, shipped straight to your door. We've hand-made our caramel corn the same way since 1937: air-popped mushroom popcorn, light buttery caramel, one family recipe, zero shortcuts.

This is the popcorn of summers in Fenwick Island, Bethany Beach, and Rehoboth Beach — scooped warm at our beach stands and packed fresh for mail order. One taste and you're back on the boardwalk, salt air and all.

A tub of Fisher's makes an easy gift — birthdays, holidays, thank-yous, and homesick Delaware beach people everywhere. And when the popcorn's gone, the tub isn't done: bring it back to any of our stands for a discounted refill, or promote it to sandcastle duty. The tub's second life is a beach tradition of its own.

A Sustainable Way To Enjoy Your Favorite Meals Wherever You Go!!

Eco-friendly cutlery set made from beautiful lightweight Bamboo. Reusable cutlery sets are great if you want to stop using disposable cutlery on the go or if you want your own cutlery in the office.

100% natural bamboo utensils. All-natural, eco-friendly, biodegradable bamboo cutlery set including fork, spoon, knife, chopsticks and a straw + cleaner brush.

This set rolls up nicely and is secured with a metal snap fasteners. It is the perfect size to keep in your car, purse, backpack, or lunchbox! Keeping a set of these utensils with you will make it easy to say no to single-use plastic utensils when you’re on the go, getting take out or wherever else!

Don’t get stuck having to use wasteful, single-use plastic utensils ever again!

Plastic cutlery was once seen as a convenient option to enjoy your favorite foods and beverages outside of the home.

However times have changed and we are now seeing the harmful effects that plastic cutlery is having on our environment.
Each year billions of plastic forks, knives, spoons and straws are used and thrown away to be recycled.

The problem is plastic cutlery can’t be properly recycled and as a result it takes thousands of years for it to break down.

Plastic cutlery isn’t safe for both wildlife and our environment and change is needed.


Bamboo Cutlery Set - The Sustainable Alternative


This reusable cutlery set is an easy, convenient way to make the switch from single-use plastic utensils.

The 5 items in this cutlery set are made of 100% natural fiber bamboo and can be reused for years to come. The utensils are long-lasting and won’t splinter or break with continued use.

Each set includes the following:

1 Bamboo Fork
1 Bamboo Spoon
1 Bamboo Serrated Knife
1 Bamboo Pair of Chopsticks
1 Bamboo Straw
1 Wire Brush Straw Cleaner

You’ll also receive a durable canvas storage bag that protects and keeps your bamboo cutlery clean.

Because this eco-friendly utensil kit is both reusable and lightweight, you’ll be able to take it with you on your next adventure - whether that be to a local restaurant, a picnic, camping or wherever your travels take you.

-Care of the cutlery is easy, Hand wash in warm water with a mild soap, rinse and let dry.

-Try not to let you bamboo items soak in the water for an extended time as they might start to split!

-Remember to wash your bamboo cutlery set with dish soap before the first use.



All bamboo is 100% compostable so you can just place it in the compost bin at the end of it’s life.
